scientific_integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible exact-rank and numerical geometric checks. The established perfect-graph facet theorem, full-dimensional volume formula, and prior two-part and split-graph metric special cases are not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Canonical coordinate Euclidean realization only; requires at least three parts with at least two nonsingleton parts for the novelty claim; finite checker samples do not prove the all-parameter theorem; historical priority provisional.
title: Multipartite stable-set polytopes: universal ridge curvature and exact five-partite cancellation
